The DSH sandbox still confines every non-escalated call; an"},{"id":"p5s3","text":" auto-approved call runs with the wider mode for exactly that one call (the same one-shot grant a hu"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"man click would produce). Do not use it on machines or sessions you would not trust a human operator"},{"id":"p5s5","text":" to run commands on."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## What it does"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"| | Workspace Write | **Auto Approval** (this plugin) | Full access |"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"| Sandbox mode | `workspace-write` | `workspace-write` | `danger-full-access` |

| Everything else | ask | ask | never asks |"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"After installing, the new preset appears in both permission surfaces:"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"- **General settings → Permission** — sets `auto-approval` as the default for future sessions;
- **`"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"/permission` picker** — switches the current session immediately (`/permission auto-approval`)."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"> While the plugin is disabled (`mode: off`), picking the Auto Approval tier behaves exactly like Wo"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"rkspace Write — the tier stays visible in both surfaces, but nothing is auto-approved."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"DSH routes every operation that needs approval through the `approval/request` waterfall (official do"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"cs: approval seam / Chinese). This plugin registers a listener with `prepend`, so it runs **before**"},{"id":"p13s3","text":" the web approval prompt:"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"1. For each request it looks up the recorded `tool/call` event by `callId` in the session log and re"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"ads the **real tool arguments** (command text, `file_path`, `workdir`) — it never trusts the model-w"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"ritten justification string.
2. The pure decision core (`lib/decide.js`) classifies the request as `"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"allow` or `defer`. Path containment is evaluated on **real identity**: the deepest existing ancestor"},{"id":"p14s5","text":" of every candidate path is resolved through `realpath` (the same mechanism the DSH filesystem sandb"},{"id":"p14s6","text":"ox uses), so symlinks and junctions cannot smuggle an auto-approval to a target outside a trusted ar"},{"id":"p14s7","text":"ea.
3. `allow` returns `allowed-once` — the request never reaches the human UI; the audit pair `appr"},{"id":"p14s8","text":"oval/asked` + `approval/decided: allowed-once` is still written to the session log, and the plugin l"},{"id":"p14s9","text":"ogs the matched rule.
4. `defer` calls `next()` — the deployment's human answerer decides as usual. "},{"id":"p14s10","text":"**The plugin never denies anything.**"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"For the formal architecture and request/decision flow, see docs/architecture.md (中文)."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"### Two-layer model: what an agent may do on the Auto Approval tier"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"The tier's permission scope decomposes into exactly two layers (the architecture doc has the full se"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"ven-layer model; this is the user-facing summary):"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"- **Inner layer: the workspace-write execution boundary** — identical to the official Workspace Writ"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"e tier, not broadened. The DSH sandbox enforces it per tool call: writes inside the session workspac"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"e and platform temp areas are allowed, everything else (file/command effects) is denied (reading any"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"where stays allowed). Operations inside the workspace are allowed directly by the sandbox — **no app"},{"id":"p18s5","text":"roval request is ever raised for them**.
- **Outer layer: the auto-approval policy (this plugin)** —"},{"id":"p18s6","text":" when an operation is denied by the inner layer and the agent explicitly retries with `sandbox_permi"},{"id":"p18s7","text":"ssions`, the plugin decides, **before** the human answerer, on a small class of verifiably safe requ"},{"id":"p18s8","text":"ests and returns `allowed-once`; everything else passes through to the human unchanged.
- **There is"},{"id":"p18s9","text":" no third layer of privilege**: auto-approval is not Full access with the prompts removed — a grante"},{"id":"p18s10","text":"d call runs once with the escalation mode the agent asked for, the session's standing tier is untouc"},{"id":"p18s11","text":"hed, and the plugin never denies anything."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"In one sentence: **Auto Approval ≠ an automatic Full access**. It is exactly *the Workspace Write sa"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"ndbox scope + an automatic adjudicator in front of the human confirmation step*."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"### Every configuration option, and what changing it does"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"| Option | Default | What it does | Effect of changing it |"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"| `mode` | `gated` | Master switch + scope | `off`: disables auto-approval entirely (the Auto Approv"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"al tier then behaves exactly like Workspace Write); `global`: auto-approve under any session tier; `"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"gated`: auto-approve only while the session tier is `auto-approval` |
| `trustedAreas` | `[]` | Trus"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"ted areas (absolute paths) | Empty: the plugin is left with only the harmless-introspection capabili"},{"id":"p22s5","text":"ty. Adding directories grants in-area git read commands, in-area simple commands, and in-area fs wri"},{"id":"p22s6","text":"tes (see "Trusted area vs outside" below) |

It never reads configuration outside its own config and settings"},{"id":"p28s3","text":" section.
- **Auditable.** Every auto-approval is a one-shot grant recorded in the session log (`app"},{"id":"p28s4","text":"roval/asked` + `approval/decided`) plus a logger line naming the matched rule; the settings card sho"},{"id":"p28s5","text":"ws the most recent decisions.
- **Fail-safe direction.** Errors in the decision path log a warning a"},{"id":"p28s6","text":"nd delegate; the plugin cannot deny, block, or lock out a session.
- **Gated config API.** `GET/PUT "},{"id":"p28s7","text":"/api/dsh-auto-approval-plugin/config` accepts only loopback (or configured `trustedHosts`) same-orig"},{"id":"p28s8","text":"in requests; cross-site fetches are rejected. It reads and writes only the plugin's own settings nam"},{"id":"p28s9","text":"espace.
- See SECURITY.md for the threat model and reporting."}],"truncated":true}
